req.title: Delete player
req.statement: The system shall delete the specified player and respond with HTTP 204 when DELETE /players/{playerId} is called.

doc.reasoning: The test suite is designed to validate the DELETE /players/{playerId} endpoint, ensuring it correctly deletes a player and handles various edge cases. The tests include a positive case to confirm successful deletion, a negative case to handle non-existent players, and a boundary case to test the deletion of the first player in the list.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_player
preconditions: Player with squad number 10 exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/10')
assert response.status_code == 204

tests.name: test_delete_non_existent_player
preconditions: Player with squad number 99 does not exist in the database.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/99')
assert response.status_code == 404

tests.name: test_delete_boundary_player
preconditions: Player with squad number 1 exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

client = TestClient(app)

response = client.delete('/players/squadnumber/1')
assert response.status_code == 204
